intent: Plan and build a full brand launch for my coffee roastery: name research, logo direction, design tokens, website, social copy, and SEO strategy.

spec.goal: Plan and build a full brand launch for the user's coffee roastery, covering name, visual identity, website, social media copy and SEO.
spec.deliverable: A brand launch package containing name research, a logo direction, a set of design tokens, a website, social media copy, and an SEO strategy for the coffee roastery.
constraints: All six parts must be covered: name research, logo direction, design tokens, website, social copy, and SEO strategy.
Everything must be for a coffee roastery business.
The name, logo direction, design tokens, website, and social copy should form one consistent brand.
Do not assume details the request does not give, such as audience, budget, location, or deadline.
done_criteria: Name research is delivered with name options for the coffee roastery.
A logo direction and a set of design tokens are provided.
A website for the roastery is built using the design tokens.
Social copy and an SEO strategy are delivered and match the brand.
spec.summary: You want a complete brand launch for your coffee roastery, including name research, logo direction, design tokens, a website, social copy, and an SEO strategy.
